contact.basis: Unmodified terrain reference at the inner castle grounds; contact at each mapped building is sampled locally.

attribution: Contains National Land Survey of Finland Elevation model 2 m data, delivered November 2026. CC BY 4.0.
method: Native float32 numeric terrain is retained in a lossless TIFF crop. The render grid projects each WGS84 east–south sample to TM35FIN and applies bilinear interpolation. No cells were replaced, masked or flattened.
limitations: The original terrain is untouched. Building floor elevations are estimates and the native terrain represents two-metre relief.
